conventions.Item: Printed item number and sub-item, e.g. 4a(1), 8b(1) row 2. "Caption" = header boxes.
conventions.Printed label: The field tooltip (/TU), which matches the printed label. If the tooltip is empty, the text printed to the left of the field.
conventions.Field name: Full official AcroForm name. Fill this exactly; no re-fielding.
conventions.Type: text / checkbox / radio / dropdown. Every choice on the mapped forms is a checkbox; none of the forms has a radio group or dropdown.
conventions.Export value: The "on" value for that checkbox. Values vary (1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 21, 99). Always set the widget's own value; never assume "Yes" or "On".
conventions.Max length: The /MaxLen limit, if the PDF sets one. None on DV-100.
conventions.Position: x0, y0, x1, y1 in points, measured from the top-left of the page (PyMuPDF convention).
conventions.Kind: question = filled from a question ID · derived = calculated · court/clerk = left blank for the court · server = completed by whoever serves · ignore = UI button.
conventions.Question ID(s): IDs from the questionnaire map. A dotted suffix names one part of a multi-part answer (L4.city, O12.places). [n] = row n (0-based) of a repeat. cards[k] = incident card k.
conventions.Rule: "= X" copies X. "check if <condition>" sets the field to its export value when true, otherwise Off. Helpers: age(dob, asOf), fmtDate() → MM/DD/YYYY, money() → 1,234.56 with no $, join(), fit() = what fits; the rest goes to an attachment. protected = roster.where(PR8 == "Y").
conventions.Fill when: Condition for filling the field. When it is false, leave the field blank or Off.
conventions.Review: Blank column for your review notes.

fillNotes.XFA: Every form except FL-155 and DV-570 is an XFA hybrid. Fill the AcroForm fields, then delete /XFA from the AcroForm dictionary. Otherwise Acrobat shows the XFA layer, which has no data.
fillNotes.Usage rights: All forms carry Reader usage rights (/Perms) except DV-570. Filling invalidates them, and Reader then warns that the document "has been changed". Remove /Perms when you save.
fillNotes.Encryption: All 31 files have an owner password and an empty user password. pypdf reads them as they are. pdf-lib needs the file decrypted first, e.g. qpdf --decrypt in.pdf out.pdf.
fillNotes.Yes/No pairs: Each box in a Yes/No (or a 3–4 option) group is its own checkbox field, not a radio group. Set one and explicitly set its siblings Off.
fillNotes.Appearances: Generate appearance streams (or set NeedAppearances = true) so filled values show in every viewer.
